what_differs: WAGR-62 (Ready, Must Have, created 2026-08-10) places Owner and Deal Version in Deal Information and holds the read-only DRA list pending DECISION-01. The next day's client sync moved Owner/Deal Version down, removed Deal Version entirely, and agreed the DRA list is read-only and synced from the CMS; later meetings (2026-09-11, 2026-09-30) confirm the CMS drives DRAs.
suggested_action: Update WAGR-62 to the current layout (no Deal Version, Owner in Additional Details, read-only CMS-synced DRA list, links columns per WAGR-170) or close it in favour of the built page and newer tickets (WAGR-209, WAGR-214, WAGR-174).
